probe_summary.model: deterministic four-receipt linear committed chain with adversarial observation
probe_summary.truncation_counterexample: The identical visible set {r1,r2} is compatible both with a complete world whose newest is r2/L2 and a truncated world containing hidden committed r3/L3; no selector using only visible receipt/artifact metadata and visible ancestry can guarantee newest-valid discovery in both.
probe_summary.revision_property: Discover exactly one committed successor by direct immutable path derived from predecessor next_effect_key, validate predecessor/artifact/resulting-LATEST bindings, and advance at most one canonical step without replay; never infer completion from list exhaustion or an ambiguous missing successor read.
probe_summary.tested_limit: Formal deterministic single-writer linear-chain model only; concurrent fork/CAS loser, transient exact-path invisibility and malformed partial successor remain untested.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded direct exact-path state/evidence transport only; no hosted compute and no receipt-list scan as compute

exact_next_action: On the next valid invocation, test the successor-addressed receipt chain under one self-local concurrent-writer/CAS-loser case and one transient exact-path-not-visible case. Require zero duplicate logical effects, never convert ambiguous 404 into completion, persist the smallest diagnostic/recovery rule, exact-read back, and stop without a second leaf.
